identificationModule.briefTitle: Efficacy and Safety of Cladribine Combined With BEAC Pretreatment Regimen in the Treatment of Peripheral T-cell Lymphoma: a Multicenter Clinical Study
identificationModule.officialTitle: Efficacy and Safety of Cladribine Combined With BEAC ( Semustine, Etoposide, Cytarabine, Cyclophosphamide) Pretreatment Regimen in the Treatment of Peripheral T-cell Lymphoma: a Multicenter Clinical Study

collaborators.name: The First Affiliated Hospital of Anhui Medical University
Affiliated Zhongshan Hospital of Dalian University

descriptionModule.briefSummary: This multi-center clinical study will evaluate the efficacy and safety of Cladribine Combined With BEAC Pretreatment Regimen in the Treatment of Peripheral T-cell Lymphoma.
descriptionModule.detailedDescription: Peripheral T-cell lymphomas (PTCL) is a group of highly heterogeneous aggressive non-Hodgkin lymphomas originating from mature post-thymic T lymphocytes or NK/T cells. The treatment effect of patients receiving autologous hematopoietic stem cell transplantation (ASCT) is better than traditional chemotherapy, but the recurrence after transplantation is still as high as 50%. It is an urgent clinical problem to reduce the recurrence after PTCL transplantation. Cladribine can kill quiescent tumor cells, which is the main reason of tumor recurrence. Since 2018, our center has used cladribine combined with BEAC pretreatment regimen to treat 20 patients with PTCL. The PFS reached 68% at 2 years, which is about 15% higher than the previous classic BEAC regimen. This multi-center clinical study will further evaluate the efficacy and safety of Cladribine combined with BEAC pretreatment regimen in the Treatment of Peripheral T-cell Lymphoma.

armGroups.label: BEAC
armGroups.description: Patients in this arm will receive BEAC (Semustine, Etoposide, Cytarabine, Cyclophosphamide) as pretreatment regimen of ASCT

armGroups.label: Cladribine combined with BEAC
armGroups.description: Patients in this arm will receive Cladribine combined with BEAC (Semustine, Etoposide, Cytarabine, Cyclophosphamide) as pretreatment regimen of ASCT

interventions.name: BEAC
interventions.description: Semustine, 300 mg/m2，-6d； Etoposide, 100 mg/m2，-5～-2d； Cytarabine, 100mg/m2，q12h，-5～-2d； Cyclophosphamide, 1.5g/m2，-5～-2d

interventions.name: Cladribine combined with BEAC
interventions.description: Cladribine, 6mg/m2，-5～-2d, two hours before Cytarabine Semustine, 300 mg/m2，-6d； Etoposide, 100 mg/m2，-5～-2d； Cytarabine, 100mg/m2，q12h，-5～-2d； Cyclophosphamide, 1.5g/m2，-5～-2d

primaryOutcomes.description: Progression-free survival was defined as the time from the date of ASCT until the date of the first documented day of disease progression or relapse, using Revised Standards for Efficacy Evaluation of Malignant Lymphoma in 2007, or death from any cause, whichever occurred first.
primaryOutcomes.timeFrame: Baseline up to data cut-off (up to approximately 2 years)

secondaryOutcomes.description: Overall survival was defined as the time from the date of ASCT to the date of death from any cause.
secondaryOutcomes.timeFrame: Baseline up to data cut-off (up to approximately 2 years)

secondaryOutcomes.description: Percentage of participants with overall response was determined on the basis of Revised Standards for Efficacy Evaluation of Malignant Lymphoma in 2007.
Transplantation-related adverse reactions are any untoward medical occurrence in a participant which is related to ASCT
secondaryOutcomes.timeFrame: Baseline up to data cut-off (up to approximately 5 years)

secondaryOutcomes.description: Percentage of participants who can tolerate the whole treatment of ASCT
secondaryOutcomes.timeFrame: Through the whole course of ASCT, an average of one month

secondaryOutcomes.description: Percentage of participants who relapse determined on the basis of Revised Standards for Efficacy Evaluation of Malignant Lymphoma in 2007.
secondaryOutcomes.timeFrame: Baseline up to data cut-off (up to approximately 5 years)
